tracking-[-0.01em]">Follow up on Shopify refunds in Gmail</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[17px] leading-[26px] text-[var(--text-secondary)]">When a Shopify refund is created, Manus reviews the order and saves a follow-up email as a Gmail draft. Nothing goes out until you send it.</p><div class="mt-auto pt-5"><button type="button" class="group clickable flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-[16px] border border-[var(--border-main)] bg-[var(--fill-tsp-white-main)] px-4 py-3.5 text-start text-[16px] leading-[24px] text-[var(--text-primary)] transition-shadow duration-200 hover:shadow-[0_12px_32px_var(--shadow-S)] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--border-input-active)]"><span class="min-w-0 flex-1">“When a Shopify refund is created, review the order and save a thoughtful follow-up email to the customer as a Gmail draft. class="font-serif w-full text-[28px] font-[600] leading-[120%] text-[var(--text-primary)] md:text-[40px]">Frequently asked questions</h2></div><div class="flex w-full flex-col items-center"><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What is AI workflow automation?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">AI workflow automation is a way to have work start on time or when something changes, then use AI to complete the work and return a useful result. With Manus, you describe the outcome, choose when it should run or what should trigger it, and review every run in Automations.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What can the Manus AI agent automate for a business?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">With AI automation you can set up automated reporting, such as a daily sales report from Google Sheets posted in Slack or a weekly industry digest, and routine work such as a Monday summary of customer emails in Gmail, a review of each new GitHub pull request, logging Gmail invoices in Google Sheets, a Notion brief before each Google Calendar meeting, or a Gmail draft follow-up after a Shopify refund. Choose what starts the work and review the result.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can Manus run scheduled and recurring tasks?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Choose a schedule that does not repeat, or one that runs daily, every weekday, weekly, monthly, on a custom pattern, or from a Cron expression. Set the time zone, use intervals of at least five minutes, and choose when the schedule ends. Your scheduled tasks are listed in Automations.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can AI task automation start without a schedule?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Choose a Trigger to start work when an event in a connected app matches your conditions. For a routine with several sources and steps, describe it in your own words with Advanced automation.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can a webhook start a Manus automation?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Create a Trigger with Webhook as the source. After you create it, copy its webhook URL and auth header from Settings. Each webhook received at that URL starts the work.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Which apps can trigger an automation?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">It depends on the apps you connect. Sources include Gmail, Outlook Mail, Mail Manus, Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, GitHub, Shopify, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Instagram, RSS, and Webhook.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can I review an automation before it sends or publishes?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Use Test run to see a real result before you rely on it. In Confirmations, choose Approval required for work that sends or publishes, or No approval needed for routines you trust.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">What happens if an automation fails?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Open the run in Updates to see what happened. You can ask AI why it failed, let Manus fix it, or pause and edit the automation, then run a test before you resume it.</p></div></div></div><div class="flex w-full max-w-[1032px] flex-col border-b border-[var(--border-light)]"><div class="group flex w-full items-start justify-between pt-6 transition-[padding-bottom,background-color] duration-300 ease-in-out clickable pb-6"><h3 class="w-full text-base font-[500] leading-5 text-[var(--text-primary)] pointer-events-none">Can each run build on earlier results?</h3><div class="flex h-6 w-6 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center ms-4 pointer-events-none"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-x text-[var(--icon-tertiary)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out rotate-45" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg></div></div><div class="grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out overflow-hidden grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"><div class="min-h-0"><p class="w-full text-base font-normal leading-6 text-[var(--text-tertiary)] pb-6 pt-0">Yes. Choose Same task to keep every run in one task with its earlier messages, files, and results, or New task to start fresh each time. Choose a Project so every run follows that project&#x27;s instructions and skills.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><section class="px-5 pb-24 pt-16 md:px-6 md:pb-32 md:pt-20"><div
